description: Sends a feature request, a missing dataset, or a note that an answer was wrong or incomplete to the Barrio Energy team, with the signed-in account's email so they can reply when it ships. Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to send feedback or a request, or says yes after you offer to send one. Never call it on your own because an answer came back empty or the user seemed dissatisfied; offer first, in one sentence, and wait for a yes. Write the request in the user's terms: what they wanted, the place or tool involved, and what was missing. Never counts toward usage limits.

email.description: Optional. Reply-to email if the user gave a different one; defaults to the signed-in account's email.

request.description: What the user wants or what was missing, in a sentence or three. Include the county, address or tool if relevant.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true: the user explicitly asked to send this or approved sending it in this conversation.

name: request_feature
title: Send a feature request or data gap to Barrio Energy
